mapper.select: select id, student_id, total_exam_count, last_exam_date, health_summary, archive_status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ch_health_archive where student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: insert into ch_health_archive (student_id, total_exam_count, last_exam_date, health_summary, archive_status, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{studentId}, #{totalExamCount}, #{lastExamDate}, #{healthSummary}, #{archiveStatus}, #{createBy}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update total_exam_count = values(total_exam_count), last_exam_date = values(last_exam_date), health_summary = values(health_summary), archive_status = values(archive_status), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now()
